messages:
maya (eng-ml): thinking out loud: propose we change onboarding to a 3-phase state machine: quick-fingerprint (fast-blocking), microbench (latency/cost sweep), and async deep-eval. Make transitions resumable and add an explicit "ready_for_hosting" marker only after microbench passes.

kai (eng-ml): sounds good. for the fingerprint phase can we rely on a deterministic token sample + checksum to catch tokenizer/shape mismatches early? keeps the fast-fail loop tiny.

ben (eng-platform): infra constraints: stage runs must be idempotent and tolerate partial worker restarts. we'll need a compact descriptor schema that contains seqlen/quant hints + replay pointer. also want a single API endpoint for kickoffs + status.

maya (eng-ml): descriptor-v2 example (sketch):
```json
{"model":"redwood/alto-3b","commit":"deadbeef","seqlen_hint":[16,128,512],"quant_candidates":["fp16","int8-q4"],"compat":{"tokenizer":"v3","kv_layer_layout":"v2"},"replay":"s3://bench/alto-3b/2026-03-23","repro_seeds":[42,7,99]}
```

sophia (product): timeline question: customers expect Hosted to show model availability quickly. what's the expected delay until a model is usable if Stage2 is queued long?

maya (eng-ml): plan is to gate full routing only after microbench; Stage2 can run async. so usable after ~30-90m typically (microbench on small fleet), deep-eval may take several hours but won't block minimal serving.

li (eng-sre): must throttle microbench so it doesn't impact prod GPUs. propose token-budget per-customer and a leaky-bucket backoff. also add concurrency limits per region.

anna (qa): quality gate proposal: auto-pass if BLEU/ROUGE-style deltas within threshold + no regression on curated golden set. borderline -> create a triage ticket with sample diffs for human review. include repro instructions pointing at replay artifact.

kai (eng-ml): add a KV warmup smoke: run a short replay to populate KV then 3 small inference probes verifying identical logits/hashes for cache hits. if mismatch, fail early and mark model as "kv-unsafe" for that runtime.

ben (eng-platform): metrics to emit per-stage: p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec, cost_estimate_per_1k_tokens, fail_rate, kv_failure_rate, and quality_delta_mean. we'll expose these in Console with a timeline and show last-successful-run id.

ops-bot: onboard request received: /api/onboard start 1789998881 -> queued on smoke-pool

maya (eng-ml): owners: maya = gate design + descriptor, ben = status API + console plumbing, anna = quality thresholds + triage flow, li = throttles/alerts. I'll assemble an RFC covering state transitions, descriptor fields, metric names, and failure semantics.

sophia (product): please include canary rules: what percent of traffic to route post-microbench and which SLA band to assign. and docs for customers on expected staging times.

kai (eng-ml): I'll prototype the kv-smoke runner and a small harness to replay token streams deterministically. aim to land tomorrow.

ben (eng-platform): will prototype a minimal status UI: state machine visualization + manual promote/rollback. Add audit log for each stage event.

li (eng-sre): SRE alerts: microbench p95 > 2x baseline for 15m -> page oncall; stage queue depth > 50 -> warn; repeated kv failures for same model -> auto-isolate the runtime variant.

anna (qa): small ask: include a reproducible seed list and the exact input artifacts in the descriptor so QA can rerun failing evaluations locally.

maya (eng-ml): good call — will include replay uri + seed list in descriptor and a minimal reproduce.sh snippet in RFC.

ben (eng-platform): also add a short TTL for descriptor requests and a rollback token that allows immediate removal from routing if post-deploy regressions occur.

maya (eng-ml): ok will add rollback_token field + recommended retention policy in RFC. I'll post draft by EOD.

kai (eng-ml): quick note: let's keep the golden seed small (<50 samples) for Stage0 to ensure consistent fast runs, and a larger stratified set for Stage2.

maya (eng-ml): agreed. thanks everyone.
